old: - Library write rule: a library write may change only the Shared Library; packs are made on the live fetch-back.
new:
- Library write rule: a library write may change only the Shared Library; packs are made on the live fetch-back.
  - THE SHARED LIBRARY HEADER FOLLOWS EVERY LIBRARY WRITE (ASK 661): the header comment of the Shared Library node reads "library sha <the first 16 hex of the sha256 of the LIB JSON>, <n> lines". The engine's Library Check (section 9, ASK 443) stops every webhook run at its start with pkgLIB2 when that sha differs from the body. So a write that changes a LIB line sets the header to the new body in the same write, and every engine write script compares the header with the body before the PUT and refuses when they differ. The readback of an engine write states that the header equals the LIB sha. A build or a write is made on a fetch that keeps each node's headerParameters; a saved fetch with them stripped is never a base, because written whole it removes the request headers of the call nodes.
